name: Paramveer Singh
kanjiName: パラムヴィール・シン
tagline: Architecting sub-10ms distributed backends, cloud-native DevSecOps, and bare-metal GPU kernels.
bio: Systems & AI Infrastructure Engineer with 55+ merged open-source PRs across vLLM, CERN, Unikraft, Google DeepMind, and CNCF Meshery. Ranked #1 globally among 2,000 participants at the University of Tokyo Matsuo-Iwasawa Lab.

competitions.title: Ranked #1 Globally — Matsuo-Iwasawa Lab AI Competition
competitions.description: Awarded Extraordinary & Honours Rank (#1 among 2,000 global participants) in deep learning systems.

competitions.title: Global Nominee — NASA International Space Apps Challenge
competitions.description: Selected from 90,000+ participants for real-time 3D orbital debris tracking and seismic telemetry.

competitions.title: National Finalist — India Innovates 2026 (Bharat Mandapam)
competitions.description: Demonstrated Cortexion real-time EEG motor-imagery Brain-Computer Interface (<45ms latency).

competitions.title: 1st Position — Innovative Product Design Expo
competitions.description: First prize among 50+ engineering teams for embedded hardware-software telemetry architecture.

experience.role: Open Source Developer (Data Plane & Networking WG)
experience.description: Cut TTFT streaming latency via immediate delta decoding (#4911), made Valkey cache tracking atomic (#4891), preserved Anthropic cache tiers (#4939), and shrank AIBrix K8s images (#2863).
Ranked #1 globally among 2,000 researchers in internal competition; engineered high-efficiency neural inference architectures.

experience.role: Open Source Developer (3D Rendering & CT Reconstruction)
experience.description: Built headless EGL rendering & glTF 2.0 3D export for LEP-era particle detectors (DELPHI/OPAL), integrated ASan/UBSan CI, and resolved CUDA ray-voxel stripe artifacts.
Hardened KraftKit unikernel CLI lifecycle & test suites in Go (8 PRs), refined CNCF Meshery Operator CRD docs, and contributed to DeepMind Torax & Formal Conjectures.
Built bare-metal Chaotic Map TRNG and real-time SHA-256/AES-128 encryption pipeline on STM32 Cortex-M4 passing all 15 NIST statistical randomness suites.

experience.role: Research Intern — Medical Robotics & Embedded Systems
experience.description: Developed multi-DOF myoelectric prosthetic control on FreeRTOS with 92% gesture accuracy and <5ms actuator latency.

publications.title: CHRONOS: Coupled Hyperchaotic Nonlinear Oscillator System for True Random Number Generation
publications.description: Hardware-efficient hyperchaotic entropy source achieving 0.9998 bits/byte Shannon entropy and passing NIST SP 800-22 & Dieharder suites.

publications.title: Deep Learning Architectures for Sanskrit Phoneme Recognition and Paninian Grammar Parsing
publications.description: Transformer acoustic-phonetic modeling for low-resource Vedic and Classical Sanskrit corpora, reducing phoneme error rate by 18.4%.
